test_name: Paga Local Colombia - K Credito (Aval PJ) Template Validation
summary: The K Credito (Aval PJ) contract for Paga Local Colombia is using the WRONG template. The system generates documents using the Activos template (FK COL - GM - Activos.docx) instead of the correct Paga Local template (FK COL paga local - Fin. COP - K Credito (Aval PJ).docx).

bug_validated.bug_description: pl_co_credito_aval_pj using wrong template (FK COL - GM - Activos.docx)

evidence.expected_template: FK COL paga local - Fin. COP - K Credito (Aval PJ).docx
evidence.actual_template_indicators: Contains 'Garantía Mobiliaria' and 'Contrato de Garantía Mobiliaria' - Activos template markers

steps_completed: Verified dashboard loads with correct tabs
Clicked on Aval Persona Juridica subtab
Verified K Credito (Aval PJ) and K Mandato PJ options visible
Clicked Solicitar for K Credito (Aval PJ)
Selected client: 3G SINTETICOS S A S (NIT: 900723680)
Received success message with contract ID: PLCRJ-2025-019
Logged in as Admin user (with legal access)
Found contract PLCRJ-2025-019 in pending review queue
Verified contract type shows 'PL Crédito Aval PJ'

validation_results.verdict: FAIL - Wrong Activos template is being used

document_evidence.title: CONTRATO DE CRÉDITO EN PESOS N° CO:900723680:1:D:M:DOM
problematic_content: Line 70: Contrato de Garantía sobre Mercancía significa un contrato de garantía mobiliaria...
Line 71: Contrato de Garantía sobre Inventario significa un contrato de garantía mobiliaria...
Line 72: Contratos de Garantía significa, indistinta o conjuntamente, el Contrato de Garantía Mobiliaria...
Line 234: Pagaré y Aval; Garantía Mobiliaria

recommendation: The bug is CONFIRMED. The backend template selection logic for contract type 'pl_co_credito_aval_pj' needs to be fixed to use the correct template 'FK COL paga local - Fin. COP - K Credito (Aval PJ).docx' instead of the Activos template.
